roles.name: canvas
roles.doc: Window and page floor.

roles.name: surface
roles.doc: Cards, cells and sheets.

roles.name: surface-raised
roles.doc: Raised cards and panels that stay in the page.

roles.name: surface-sunken
roles.doc: Inset fields and grouped backgrounds.

roles.name: line
roles.doc: Decorative separators and card borders; interactive boundaries use line-strong.

roles.name: text
roles.doc: Body text.

roles.name: text-muted
roles.doc: Secondary text.

roles.name: text-faint
roles.doc: Hints and disabled text.

roles.name: accent
roles.doc: Primary actions, selection, links and text buttons: reads as text on canvas and surface.

roles.name: on-accent
roles.doc: Text and icons on accent.

roles.name: accent-soft
roles.doc: Tinted containers and selected rows.

roles.name: on-accent-soft
roles.doc: Text on accent-soft.

roles.name: danger
roles.doc: Destructive actions and errors.

roles.name: on-danger
roles.doc: Text and icons on danger.

roles.name: danger-soft
roles.doc: Error containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: success
roles.doc: Success state.

roles.name: on-success
roles.doc: Text and icons on success.

roles.name: success-soft
roles.doc: Success containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: warning
roles.doc: Warning state.

roles.name: on-warning
roles.doc: Text and icons on warning.

roles.name: warning-soft
roles.doc: Warning containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: focus
roles.doc: Focus ring.

roles.name: scrim
roles.doc: Modal backdrop, translucent; a pack without it takes a near-black of its own neutral.

roles.name: chart-1
roles.doc: First categorical series.

roles.name: chart-2
roles.doc: Second categorical series.

roles.name: chart-3
roles.doc: Third categorical series.

roles.name: chart-4
roles.doc: Fourth categorical series.

roles.name: chart-5
roles.doc: Fifth categorical series.

roles.name: line-strong
roles.doc: Interactive boundaries: editor borders and control outlines.

roles.name: selection
roles.doc: Selected-text background, from the accent's soft tone.

roles.name: shadow
roles.doc: Elevation shadow ink; `shadow-*` layers take it at their alpha.

roles.name: media
roles.doc: Translucent dock over video and images; the same in both appearances; a pack without it takes a near-black of its own neutral.

roles.name: on-media
roles.doc: Text and icons over media; tracks and buffered ranges take it at an alpha (`on-media/25`).

roles.name: surface-overlay
roles.doc: Anything floating over the page: menus, popovers, toasts, dialogs and sheets; surface-raised, a step lighter in dark.

roles.name: knob
roles.doc: The thumb of a switch or slider, drawn on an accent-solid track; white by default, or the dark ink of a light seed's accent-solid.

roles.name: success-mark
roles.doc: Success as a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: warning-mark
roles.doc: Warning as a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: danger-mark
roles.doc: Danger as a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: media-canvas
roles.doc: The whole screen behind a full-screen picture or video: opaque, near-black in both appearances; a pack without it takes a near-black of its own neutral.

roles.name: info
roles.doc: Information that is neither good nor bad: notices and hints; a fixed blue at the accent's strength, or the accent family when the accent is that blue.

roles.name: on-info
roles.doc: Text and icons on info.

roles.name: info-soft
roles.doc: Information containers; text on it uses text.

roles.name: info-mark
roles.doc: Information as a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-1
roles.doc: First categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-2
roles.doc: Second categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-3
roles.doc: Third categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-4
roles.doc: Fourth categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-5
roles.doc: Fifth categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-6
roles.doc: Sixth categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-7
roles.doc: Seventh categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-8
roles.doc: Eighth categorical hue, for tags, avatars and series past the chart colours: a dot or shape, never text.

roles.name: hue-1-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the first hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-2-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the second hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-3-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the third hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-4-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the fourth hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-5-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the fifth hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-6-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the sixth hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-7-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the seventh hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: hue-8-soft
roles.doc: Fill behind the eighth hue; text on it uses text.

roles.name: chart-6
roles.doc: Sixth categorical series.

roles.name: chart-7
roles.doc: Seventh categorical series.

roles.name: chart-8
roles.doc: Eighth categorical series.

roles.name: accent-solid
roles.doc: Fill of a control that is pressed or switched: primary buttons, checked boxes and radios, switch tracks, a selected day, steppers, floating buttons; the accent in light, a deeper accent in dark, under white marks. A light seed, such as a yellow, stays the fill in both, under dark marks. Accent text, icons, the focus ring and filled labels such as badges keep accent.

roles.name: on-accent-solid
roles.doc: Text and icons on accent-solid.

roles.name: danger-solid
roles.doc: Fill of a destructive control that is pressed and carries white marks; danger in light, a deeper danger in dark. A danger badge or label keeps danger.

roles.name: on-danger-solid
roles.doc: Text and icons on danger-solid.

roles.name: accent-solid-hover
roles.doc: accent-solid under a hovering pointer: a visible step deeper, or lighter where deeper would make its label hard to read; hue kept. Always derived; a pack does not write it.

roles.name: accent-solid-pressed
roles.doc: accent-solid while pressed: the same step again past hover, in the same direction. Always derived; a pack does not write it.

roles.name: danger-solid-hover
roles.doc: danger-solid under a hovering pointer: a visible step deeper, or lighter where deeper would make its label hard to read; hue kept. Always derived; a pack does not write it.

roles.name: danger-solid-pressed
roles.doc: danger-solid while pressed: the same step again past hover, in the same direction. Always derived; a pack does not write it.

roles.name: neutral-soft
roles.doc: Translucent fill of the theme's own neutral behind initials and placeholders, dark in light and light in dark, raised in alpha only as far as it shows as an edge on every floor, 3:1 under high contrast; text on it uses text.

roles.name: line-on-raised
roles.doc: `line` as drawn inside a raised surface: the contrast `line` has on surface, at least 1.3:1, 3:1 under high contrast.

roles.name: line-strong-on-raised
roles.doc: `line-strong` as drawn inside a raised surface: the contrast `line-strong` has on surface, at least 3:1.

roles.name: line-on-overlay
roles.doc: `line` as drawn inside an overlay: the contrast `line` has on surface, at least 1.3:1, 3:1 under high contrast.

roles.name: line-strong-on-overlay
roles.doc: `line-strong` as drawn inside an overlay: the contrast `line-strong` has on surface, at least 3:1.

roles.name: danger-on-raised
roles.doc: `danger` as drawn inside a raised surface: the contrast `danger` has on surface, at least 4.5:1, so destructive text reads there. `under` maps by role, so a `danger` fill there takes it too; destructive fills use `danger-solid`.

roles.name: danger-on-overlay
roles.doc: `danger` as drawn inside an overlay: the contrast `danger` has on surface, at least 4.5:1, so destructive text reads there. `under` maps by role, so a `danger` fill there takes it too; destructive fills use `danger-solid`.

frame.doc: Every message the core hands a platform adapter: the presented frame snapshot, semantic nodes, automation exchanges, input-protocol replies and the text menu. Type grammar: string, bool, u8, u32, u64, i64, usize, f32, f64, any; T? may be absent or null; T[] is a list; T[n] a fixed list; other names refer to types below.

fieldDocs.AutomationFrame.passes: Raw: a list of composite draw records when the frame composites, else per-pass timing pairs in µs; renderer diagnostics no adapter reads.
fieldDocs.AutomationFrame.video: Raw: the GPU video players' diagnostics (first-frame phases, rebinds, quality switches); its shape follows the video renderer, and no adapter reads it.
fieldDocs.AutomationFrame.reveal: Raw: the reveal watchdog's diagnostics; no adapter reads it.

appearance.doc: The effective appearance: the lxapp's fixed one, else the user's preference, else the product default, else the system.

viewport.doc: The page surface in logical pixels.

insets.doc: System bars and host chrome over the surface, logical pixels.

safeArea.doc: The system bars alone (status bar, cutout, home indicator), as CSS `env(safe-area-inset-*)`; a dialog covering host chrome pads by these, logical pixels.

hinge.doc: Physical display hinge/crease intersecting this page canvas in local logical pixels; null when absent.

capsule.type: Readonly<{ x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number }> | null
capsule.doc: The host's capsule (the ··· and close control) where it floats over the page, in page coordinates, logical pixels; `null` when the host shows none or it sits in a nav bar. The same box Web pages read as `--lx-page-chrome-capsule-*`.

pointer.doc: `fine` pointers (mouse, trackpad) hover; `coarse` ones (touch) do not.

os.doc: The host OS, the same value as Logic's `lx.host.info.os` and `lx.device.info.osName`.

sizeClass.doc: `compact` below 600 logical pixels of page width, else `regular`, with 24 pixels of hysteresis: compact holds until 624, regular until below 576. Near the edge it can disagree with `min-[600px]:`; use `sizeClass` for structure and `min-[…]:` for spacing and type.

language.doc: The language the page's text is in: the host's display language narrowed to the `languages` its lxapp.json lists. `t`, built-in words, direction and glyph forms follow it.

reducedMotion.doc: The system asks for reduced motion; `motion-reduce:`/`motion-safe:` follow it.

highContrast.doc: The system asks for increased contrast; the palette resolves its high-contrast variant.

animatorDurationScale.doc: The platform's animation duration multiplier (0..10, default 1); 0 also sets `reducedMotion`.

hourCycle.doc: 12- or 24-hour clock: the user's system setting, else the custom of the system language.

firstWeekday.doc: The first day of the week, a `Weekday` (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday): the user's system setting, else the custom of the system language.

canDock.doc: Whether the window can dock an `as: 'aside'` beside the main; false until the host reports it.

renderer.doc: `fallback: "driver"` when this device's GPU driver failed and pages render on the CPU.

textScale.doc: How much the system's text size grows body text: 1 at the default size, 2 when it is twice as large, after the lxapp's `maxTextScale`. Sizes already follow it; read it only for a layout that must change shape, such as fewer columns.

palette.doc: The resolved theme: `{ revision, colors }`, one #rrggbbaa per role slot; the page never sees it.

scales.doc: The resolved pack scales: `{ revision, values }`, one value per scale slot (points, ms for durations, a timing function for easings); the page never sees it.

width.doc: Width in logical pixels, a percent of the parent, a viewport unit, `ch`, or an intrinsic size.

height.doc: Height in logical pixels, a percent of the parent, a viewport unit, or an intrinsic size.

minWidth.doc: The smallest width layout may give it.

minHeight.doc: The smallest height layout may give it.

maxWidth.doc: The largest width layout may give it.

aspectRatio.doc: Width divided by height, kept when only one of them is set.

maxHeight.doc: The largest height layout may give it.

margin.doc: Space outside the border on every side; `auto` takes the free space.

marginInlineStart.doc: Space outside the start border: left in left-to-right text, right in right-to-left.

marginInlineEnd.doc: Space outside the end border: right in left-to-right text, left in right-to-left.

position.doc: `relative` offsets it from its place; `absolute` places it in its parent; `fixed` in the screen; `sticky` sticks inside its scroll.

inset.doc: Offset of every edge from the containing box, for a positioned element.

top.doc: Offset of the top edge; `anchor(center)` centres an anchored popover on its anchor.

right.doc: Offset of the right edge; `anchor(center)` centres an anchored popover on its anchor.

bottom.doc: Offset of the bottom edge; `anchor(center)` centres an anchored popover on its anchor.

left.doc: Offset of the left edge; `anchor(center)` centres an anchored popover on its anchor.

insetInlineStart.doc: Offset of the start edge, following the text direction.

insetInlineEnd.doc: Offset of the end edge, following the text direction.

zIndex.doc: Paint order among siblings; higher paints over lower.

positionArea.type: "bottom span-inline-end" | "bottom span-inline-start" | "bottom" | "top span-inline-end" | "top span-inline-start" | "top" | "inline-end span-block-end" | "inline-end span-block-start" | "inline-end" | "inline-start span-block-end" | "inline-start span-block-start" | "inline-start"
positionArea.doc: Where an anchored popover sits against its anchor; it flips when that side lacks room.

flexGrow.doc: Share of the free space along the main axis it takes.

flexShrink.doc: Share of the overflow along the main axis it gives up; 0 keeps its size.

flexBasis.doc: Main-axis size before free space is shared out.

alignSelf.doc: Cross-axis alignment of this item, overriding its parent's `alignItems`.

gridColumn.doc: Grid columns it spans, as `start / end` or `span n`.

gridColumnStart.doc: Grid line its column span starts at.

gridColumnEnd.doc: Grid line its column span ends at, or `span n`.

gridRow.doc: Grid rows it spans, as `start / end` or `span n`.

gridRowStart.doc: Grid line its row span starts at.

gridRowEnd.doc: Grid line its row span ends at, or `span n`.

justifySelf.doc: Inline alignment of this grid item in its cell.

order.doc: Layout order among flex or grid siblings; lower comes first.

opacity.doc: Opacity of the element and its subtree, 0..1.

overflow.doc: `hidden` clips the subtree to the border box and its radius.

backgroundColor.doc: Fill behind the content, as a colour role.

backgroundImage.doc: A linear, radial or conic gradient painted behind the content.

borderStartStartRadius.doc: Radius of the top corner on the start side.

borderStartEndRadius.doc: Radius of the top corner on the end side.

borderEndStartRadius.doc: Radius of the bottom corner on the start side.

borderEndEndRadius.doc: Radius of the bottom corner on the end side.

borderInlineStartWidth.doc: Width of the start-side border, following the text direction.

borderInlineEndWidth.doc: Width of the end-side border, following the text direction.

borderColor.doc: Colour of every border, as a colour role.

boxShadow.doc: Shadows painted outside the border box, up to the first listed on top.

ring.doc: A focus-style outline: an outer ring with an optional gap, and an inner ring.

backdropFilter.doc: Filter applied to what is behind it, such as `blur(12px)` for frosted glass.

translate.doc: Moves it without changing layout, in pixels or percents of its own size.

rotate.doc: Rotation in degrees around `transformOrigin`, without changing layout.

scale.doc: Scale, uniform or `[x, y]`, around `transformOrigin`, without changing layout.

transformOrigin.doc: The point `rotate` and `scale` turn around, as fractions `[x, y]` of its box.

filter.doc: Filter applied to its own pixels, such as `blur(4px)` or `grayscale(1)`.

padding.doc: Space inside the border on every side.

paddingInlineStart.doc: Space inside the start border, following the text direction.

paddingInlineEnd.doc: Space inside the end border, following the text direction.

display.doc: `flex` (the default) or `grid` lays out children; `none` removes it from layout.

touchTarget.doc: `none` keeps presses to its own box instead of widening it to the platform touch target.

flexDirection.doc: Main axis of a flex container; `<view>` is a column unless set.

justifyContent.doc: Main-axis placement of the children and the space between them.

alignContent.doc: Placement of wrapped lines or grid tracks in the cross axis.

flexWrap.doc: Whether children wrap onto more lines when they do not fit.

gap.doc: Space between children in both axes.

gridTemplateColumns.doc: Column tracks of a grid: a count of equal columns, or a track list.

gridTemplateRows.doc: Row tracks of a grid: a count of equal rows, or a track list.

gridAutoColumns.doc: Size of columns the grid creates on its own.

gridAutoRows.doc: Size of rows the grid creates on its own.

gridAutoFlow.doc: Direction items without a place fill the grid in; `dense` fills earlier holes.

justifyItems.doc: Inline alignment of every grid item in its cell.

color.doc: Text and icon colour, as a colour role; inherited.

fontSize.doc: Font size in logical pixels, scaled by the system text size; inherited.

fontFamily.doc: A generic family or a font the app declares; inherited.

lineHeight.doc: Line height as a multiple of the font size, or in pixels; inherited.

letterSpacing.doc: Extra space between letters, in pixels or `em`; inherited.

fontVariantNumeric.doc: Numeric glyph variants such as `tabular-nums`; inherited.

userSelect.doc: Whether its text can be selected and copied; inherited.

textAlign.doc: Horizontal alignment of lines; `start` and `end` follow the text direction.

textDecorationColor.doc: Colour of the decoration, as a colour role.

textTransform.doc: Case change applied when shown; the text itself is unchanged.

backgroundClip.doc: `text` paints the background through the glyphs only.

whiteSpace.doc: How spaces and newlines collapse and whether lines wrap.

wordBreak.doc: Where words may break: anywhere (`break-all`), or never inside CJK runs (`keep-all`).

overflowWrap.doc: Whether a word longer than the line breaks inside rather than overflowing.

lineClamp.doc: Lines shown at most; the rest is cut with an ellipsis.

textOverflow.doc: `ellipsis` ends a cut line with an ellipsis.

overscrollBehavior.doc: `contain` keeps a scroll at its edge from moving an outer one; `none` also drops the bounce.

scrollSnapStop.doc: `always` stops a swipe at each snap point instead of skipping past.

scrollSnapType.doc: Axis a scroll snaps along, to its children's `scrollSnapAlign`.

scrollSnapAlign.doc: Edge of this child a snapping scroll rests on.

placeholderColor.doc: Colour of an editor's placeholder, as a colour role.

objectFit.doc: How the picture fills its box: `cover` crops, `contain` letterboxes, `fill` stretches.

objectPosition.doc: Where the picture sits in its box when it does not fill it, such as `top` or `25% 75%`.

propDocs.aria-level: A `treeitem`'s depth, 1..32; Left and Right walk between levels.
propDocs.aria-valuenow: The value of a `progressbar`, a `spinbutton` or an `onPointer` element, between `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`; leave it out while a progressbar's amount is unknown. On an `onPointer` element it is the value arrows and a screen reader step.
propDocs.aria-activedescendant: The id of the option the editor's keys point at while focus stays in the text; a screen reader hears that option as it changes.
propDocs.aria-controls: With `role="combobox"`: the ids (1..8, space-separated) of the list it opens. Assistive tech and automation read them; an id that names no element is left out.
propDocs.aria-current: The current item of a set: `"page"` in navigation, `"step"` in a progress of steps, `true` otherwise; `false` or absent for the rest.
propDocs.aria-autocomplete: With `role="combobox"`: `"list"` when typing filters the list it opens.
propDocs.aria-modal: On a popover with `role="dialog"`: modal like a `<dialog>`. Tab stays inside, the rest of the page leaves accessibility, and the page shows over the host's bars; without it the popover dialog is non-modal.
propDocs.aria-checked: Checked state of a `radio`, `menuitemcheckbox` or `menuitemradio` item; `"mixed"` on a `menuitemcheckbox` that is partly checked.
propDocs.bleed: On a direct child of `<page>`: extend under the safe-area insets to the screen edge, on every side or the named ones.
propDocs.onPage: Called for PageUp and PageDown on a `role="grid"`.
propDocs.onContextMenu: Called for a long press or a secondary click, with where it happened.
propDocs.onPointer: Reports a single pointer over the element: down, move, up, enter, leave and cancel.
propDocs.pointerAxis: The axis `onPointer` keeps; the other is left to the page's scroll.
propDocs.onLayout: Called with its laid-out size after each change, one render behind.
propDocs.box: A `useBox` handle this element fills with its laid-out size.
propDocs.aria-label: The accessible name, spoken in place of its text.
propDocs.popover: Makes it a popover in the top layer: `auto` light-dismisses, `manual` closes only when told, `hint` for a hover hint.
propDocs.onToggle: Called with the new state when the popover opens or closes.
propDocs.drag: Lets the finger move it and its subtree along one axis, between its `dragSnapPoints`.
propDocs.dragSnapPoints: Up to 8 offsets, in pixels or percents of its size, a drag comes to rest at.
propDocs.bind: A number `useLocal` cell holding the index of the snap point it rests on.
propDocs.snapIndex: The index of the snap point it rests on, with `onSnapChange`; not with `bind`.
propDocs.onSnapChange: Called with the snap point index it came to rest at after a drag or swipe.
propDocs.onDragEnd: Called when a drag is released, with the snap index it heads for and its velocity.
propDocs.aria-actions: Ids of buttons (space-separated) a screen reader offers as this element's actions, as for a swipe row.
propDocs.onPointerEnter: Called when a mouse, stylus or trackpad pointer enters it.
propDocs.onPointerLeave: Called when that pointer leaves it.
propDocs.closeAfter: On a `popover="manual"`: close it this many milliseconds (1..60000) after it opens, as a toast.
propDocs.onCloseRequest: Called when Escape, back or a screen reader asks the popover to close; return `false` to keep it open.
propDocs.title: The title the host navigation bar shows for the page; the page's only title writer, so Logic changes it through page data, not `navigationBar.update`.
propDocs.onClick: Called when it is pressed: a tap, a click, Enter or Space, or a screen reader's activation. `event.timeStamp` is when the press arrived, in epoch ms.
propDocs.disabled: Refuses input and shows the disabled style; it stays in accessibility, marked unavailable.
propDocs.popoverTarget: The id of a popover a press opens or closes.
propDocs.interestFor: The id of a `popover="hint"` shown while the pointer rests on it or it has focus.
propDocs.keepOpen: On a menu item: run `onClick` and leave the menu open.
propDocs.keepsFocus: A press leaves the focused editor editing: its caret, selection and keyboard stay, as a format bar above the keyboard needs.
propDocs.onReachStart: Called when the scroll reaches its start, as for loading older items.
propDocs.onReachEnd: Called when the scroll reaches its end, as for loading more items.
propDocs.onScrollEdge: Called when the scroll reaches or leaves either edge, and on mount with the edges it starts at.
propDocs.onPaste: Called when the user pastes, before anything is inserted: `text` raw, `html` as the source app wrote it (unsanitised; absent for a plain paste or a secure editor). Call `event.preventDefault()` synchronously to insert your own result, usually with `replaceRange(selection.start, selection.end, …)`; otherwise the plain text is inserted, a single-line editor taking newlines as spaces.
propDocs.onVisibleChange: Called with the children on screen (an element with an `id`, or a `List` row by its key) when that set, a child's ratio by a quarter step, or the current child changes, and once with exact values when the scroll comes to rest.
propDocs.count: How many rows the list has.
propDocs.row: Renders the row at an index; only rows near the screen are rendered.
propDocs.height: The height of the row at an index, when rows differ; rows are measured otherwise.
propDocs.itemKeys: A stable key per row, so state and position follow an item when rows move.
propDocs.items: The items, one row each; only rows near the screen are rendered.
propDocs.getKey: A stable, short key for an item, so state and position follow it when items move.
propDocs.renderItem: Renders the row for an item.
propDocs.getItemHeight: The height of an item's row, when rows differ; rows are measured otherwise.
propDocs.placeholder: Shown while the value is empty.
propDocs.alt: What the image shows, spoken by a screen reader; empty for a decorative image.
propDocs.retryKey: Change it to load the same `src` again after an error.
propDocs.onKeyDown: Keys the editor handles before typing: a map from key name to a handler returning `true` when it took the key.
propDocs.readOnly: The text can be selected and copied but not changed.
propDocs.onFocus: Called when the editor gains focus.
propDocs.onSelectionChange: Called at most once a frame when the caret moves, the selection changes or where it shows changes: `start` and `end` are UTF-16 offsets, as `value.slice(start, end)` reads them; `caret` and `rects` are in page points. To place a menu at the caret, anchor a popover to `<id>:caret` instead. Needs `bind` for `setSelection` and `replaceRange` on the cell.
propDocs.onBlur: Called when the editor loses focus.
propDocs.type: The kind of value: picks the keyboard, masking, and the date or time picker.
propDocs.inputMode: The on-screen keyboard to show, without changing what is accepted.
propDocs.autoFocus: Focus the editor when it first appears.
propDocs.onSubmit: Called with the text for the keyboard's action key, or Enter on a single-line editor.
propDocs.maxLength: The most characters it holds; typing stops there.
propDocs.autoComplete: What the value is, so the system can offer saved or received values, such as a one-time code.
propDocs.enterKeyHint: The label of the keyboard's action key.
propDocs.autoCapitalize: Which letters the keyboard capitalises on its own.
propDocs.spellCheck: Whether misspellings are marked and corrected.
propDocs.rows: Lines it shows when empty; it grows with its text up to `maxRows`.
propDocs.maxRows: Lines it grows to before it scrolls.
propDocs.indeterminate: Shows a mixed state, as for a parent of partly checked items; a press clears it.
propDocs.defaultChecked: Where an unbound control starts; it applies once.
propDocs.options: The choices, each a value and a label.
propDocs.secondaryValue: A second range drawn behind the value, such as buffered media.
propDocs.aria-valuetext: Spoken in place of the number, such as "1:20 of 3:05".
propDocs.onPressChange: Called with `true` when a finger or pointer takes the thumb and `false` when it lets go.
propDocs.onClose: Called for a request to close: Escape, back, a backdrop tap or a sheet dragged off; it closes when you set `open` to false.
propDocs.closedby: The close requests it takes: `closerequest` (default) Escape and back, `any` also a backdrop tap, `none` none.
propDocs.kind: The chart: bars, a line, or a pie.
propDocs.values: The data, one number per bar, point or slice.
propDocs.colors: Chart colour roles, 1..16, cycled over bars and slices; a line uses the first.
propDocs.smooth: Draw a line chart as a smooth curve.
propDocs.selectedIndex: The highlighted bar, point or slice; pass back what `onSelect` reports.
propDocs.domainMin: The lowest value the axis shows; it must contain zero and every value.
propDocs.domainMax: The highest value the axis shows; it must contain zero and every value.
propDocs.onSelect: Called with the index of the bar, point or slice a press picks.
propDocs.pieLayout: The pie's centre and radii, as fractions of the box.
propDocs.markerEmphasisScale: How much larger the selected point's marker is drawn.
propDocs.paths: The shapes to draw: SVG path data with a fill and a stroke each.
propDocs.gradients: Up to 8 named gradients the paths use as `fill: 'url(#id)'`.
propDocs.viewBox: The drawing's coordinate box, `[x, y, width, height]`, scaled to fit the element.
propDocs.to: The page a press navigates to, with its params.
propDocs.sources: The same video at several qualities; not with `src`.
propDocs.player: A `useVideo` player: control it from code, or show the same player in another `<video>`.
propDocs.poster: An image shown until the first frame.
propDocs.paused: Pause or play; applies on mount and when it changes.
propDocs.muted: Mute or unmute; applies on mount and when it changes.
propDocs.onLoadedMetadata: Called when the duration and size are known.
propDocs.onPlay: Called when playback is asked to start.
propDocs.onPlaying: Called when frames start moving, after a start or a stall.
propDocs.onPause: Called when playback pauses, with why.
propDocs.onWaiting: Called when playback stalls for data.
propDocs.onSeeked: Called when a seek has finished, with the new time.
propDocs.onTimeUpdate: Called as the playback time moves, a few times a second.
propDocs.onEnded: Called when playback reaches the end.
propDocs.onRateChange: Called when the playback speed changes.
propDocs.onVolumeChange: Called when the volume or mute changes.
propDocs.onQualityChange: Called when a new quality is on screen.
propDocs.onFullscreenChange: Called when it enters or leaves full screen.
propDocs.web: A `useWebView` document: pass the same one to each `<webview>` that shows it, keeping one live page.
propDocs.handlesDrags: The web page handles its own drags (a map, a canvas); a drag starting on it never passes to the page.
propDocs.onMessage: Called with what the web page posts through `window.lingxia.postMessage`.
propDocs.onBlocked: Called with a navigation the host cancelled: outside trustedDomains, or not https.

anchor.doc: The id of the element a popover is placed against; `<id>:caret` or `<id>:selection` follows an editor's caret or selection each frame.

open.doc: Whether the popover is shown; with `onToggle` to follow its own closing.

aria-valuetext.doc: With `role="combobox"`: what is chosen, spoken after the name.

bind.doc: A number `useLocal` cell holding the index of the snap point a `scrollSnapType` scroll rests on.

snapIndex.doc: The index of the snap point a `scrollSnapType` scroll rests on, with `onSnapChange`; not with `bind`.

anchor.type: "end" | { index: number; align: "start" | "end"; seq?: number; duration?: number }
anchor.doc: `"end"` starts at the last row; `{ index, align, seq }` scrolls there, again whenever `seq` changes.

src.doc: The picture: a package path, an `lx://` file, or a URL on an allowed host; PNG or JPEG.

placeholder.doc: A picture shown until `src` has loaded, and if it fails.

onLoad.doc: Called once per `src` and `retryKey`, when the picture has loaded.

onError.doc: Called once per `src` and `retryKey`, when the picture fails to load.

min.doc: The lowest value: a number for `type="number"`, a date or time string for a picker.

max.doc: The highest value: a number for `type="number"`, a date or time string for a picker.

step.doc: The interval a number snaps to.

defaultValue.doc: Where an unbound slider starts, snapped to `step`; it applies once.

aria-modal.doc: Always true for a `<dialog>`; `false` is refused.

open.doc: Whether the dialog is shown; with `onClose` to follow a close request.

defaultValue.doc: The option an unbound select starts on; it applies once.

src.doc: The video to play; not with `sources`.

onError.doc: Called when the video fails to load or play.

onVolumeChange.type: (event: { readonly volume: number; readonly muted: boolean } & TimeStamped) => void

onLoad.doc: Called when a page has loaded, with its address and title.

onError.doc: Called when a page fails to load.

rules.doc: Authoring admission the wire does not carry. The runtime, the compiler's static audit, authoring.d.ts and the reference all read it. role: where each role goes; elementRole: the roles an element takes and the one it implies; prop: what a prop needs once set; run: the props every element takes that a run inside <text> (a <span>, a <link> there) takes too. trait: a key prop the other props need (with the key absent they fail; each form of the key takes them, less its without); it generates a union in authoring.d.ts and the prop rules. exclusive: props of which at most one is set, each with the companions it needs (with); orElse is required when none is set (missing words that); a union in authoring.d.ts and the prop rules. A rule passes when every condition holds: tags (the element, a <link> outside <text> counting as link-box), role (the authored role, or the element's implied one), with (props present and not empty), not (a prop holding one of these values fails it), any (at least one of these condition sets holds). on limits a prop rule to those elements; value limits it to that value of its prop. error is the message without its code; a role rule's default names where it goes.

img.error: role="img" goes on a <view> or <text> with an aria-label, which is spoken in place of its content

dialog.error: role="dialog" goes on a popover <view>, or is the <dialog> element

page.error: the <page> keeps its own role; put a role on an element inside it

text.error: a <text> takes role heading, listitem, alert, status, tooltip, gridcell, option or img; put other roles on a <view> or <button>

button.error: a <button> takes an item role (tab, radio, option, gridcell, treeitem, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio) or combobox; put container roles on a <view>

scroll.error: a <scroll> takes a container role: list, listbox, grid, menu, group or tree

list.error: a <List> takes a container role: list, listbox, grid, menu, group or tree

input.error: an <input> takes role combobox or spinbutton only

link-box.error: a block <link> takes only role="menuitem", as a navigation row of a menu

dialog.error: a <dialog> keeps its own role; only role="alertdialog" marks one that interrupts

popover.error: {prop} belongs to a popover; add popover

without.onCloseRequest: onCloseRequest belongs on a popover that is not manual; nothing but your code closes a manual one

drag.error: {prop} belongs to an element with drag; add drag="x" or drag="y"

pointer.error: pointerAxis needs onPointer on the same element; add onPointer or remove pointerAxis

snap.error: {prop} and {other} both set the snap index; bind a useLocal cell, or pass snapIndex and update it from onSnapChange
snap.companion: {prop} reports the snap index you pass in snapIndex; add snapIndex, or bind a useLocal cell instead
snap.needs: {prop} controls the position, so it needs onSnapChange to hear where a swipe settled; use bind to let the element keep the index itself

videoSource.error: {prop} and {other} both name the video; give src for one file, or sources for a choice of quality
videoSource.missing: a <video> needs a source: add src (one file) or sources (a choice of quality), or player={useVideo(name)} to show a player another <video> gives a source

aria-valuenow.error: role="combobox" takes aria-valuetext only, a string
aria-valuenow, -valuemin, -valuemax and -valuetext belong on role="progressbar", "spinbutton" or "combobox", or an onPointer element

aria-valuemin.error: role="combobox" takes aria-valuetext only, a string
aria-valuenow, -valuemin, -valuemax and -valuetext belong on role="progressbar", "spinbutton" or "combobox", or an onPointer element

aria-valuemax.error: role="combobox" takes aria-valuetext only, a string
aria-valuenow, -valuemin, -valuemax and -valuetext belong on role="progressbar", "spinbutton" or "combobox", or an onPointer element

aria-valuetext.error: aria-valuenow, -valuemin, -valuemax and -valuetext belong on role="progressbar", "spinbutton" or "combobox", or an onPointer element

aria-controls.error: aria-controls and aria-autocomplete belong on role="combobox"

aria-autocomplete.error: aria-controls and aria-autocomplete belong on role="combobox"

aria-checked.error: aria-checked="mixed" goes on role="menuitemcheckbox"; a <checkbox> takes indeterminate
aria-checked goes on role="radio", "menuitemcheckbox" or "menuitemradio"; a checkbox has its own checked

aria-modal.error: aria-modal belongs on a popover with role="dialog"
a <dialog> is always modal; a non-modal dialog is a popover with role="dialog"

keepOpen.error: keepOpen belongs on a menu item: role="menuitem", "menuitemcheckbox" or "menuitemradio"

UI_A11Y.when: An image lacks alt, or a control, editor, plot, select, dialog or webview lacks an accessible name.
UI_A11Y.fix: Add alt (or alt="" when decorative) on <image>, or aria-label / visible text on the control.

UI_ACTION.when: An action call was malformed, cyclic, unknown, or its reply was invalid.
UI_ACTION.fix: Call a declared action from view.actions with at most one acyclic JSON payload.

UI_ANIMATION.when: An animation definition is invalid or over budget, or style.animation was set inline.
UI_ANIMATION.fix: Use animate-* utilities with valid @keyframes in the theme stylesheet and keep definitions within animationBytes.

UI_BACK.when: useBackHandler was given an enabled flag that is not a boolean or an onBack that is not a function.
UI_BACK.fix: Pass a boolean enabled and an onBack function to useBackHandler.

UI_BLEED_PARENT.when: bleed was placed on an element that is not a direct child of <page>.
UI_BLEED_PARENT.fix: Move bleed to a direct child of <page>.

UI_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT.when: Logic did not deliver the first page state in time.
UI_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT.fix: Ensure the page Logic initializes and resolves its initial state promptly without blocking.

UI_BRIDGE.when: The View-Logic connection failed or was replaced.
UI_BRIDGE.fix: Reload the page or verify the host bridge session is still active.

UI_BUDGET.when: A frame used at least three quarters of a page limit, or a dialog or popover past topLayer stayed closed.
UI_BUDGET.fix: Reduce rendered nodes/overlays or virtualise long lists with <List>.

UI_BUFFER.when: A malformed wire buffer reached the native decoder.
UI_BUFFER.fix: Rebuild the page with a matching @lingxia/view compiler and host SDK.

UI_BUTTON.when: A button label is invalid, a scroll, list or webview sits inside a composed control, or a control wraps only another control.
UI_BUTTON.fix: Move scroll/list/webview outside pressable controls and put the action directly on the inner control.

UI_CHANNEL.when: A useChannel call, channel handler, payload or frame is invalid.
UI_CHANNEL.fix: Pass a valid channel action name, acyclic JSON params and a valid onData handler.

UI_CHECK.when: A checkbox or switch value, defaultChecked, label or binding is invalid.
UI_CHECK.fix: Bind a boolean useLocal cell or pass a boolean value with onChange.

UI_CHILD.when: An element has children it does not accept, or lacks its required parent.
UI_CHILD.fix: Match the element child kind in elements.md (leaf elements take no children; runs belong inside <text>).

UI_CHROME.when: The platform adapter reported invalid host chrome geometry.
UI_CHROME.fix: Check the host platform adapter chrome inset measurements.

UI_CLASS.when: A className is not a string, exceeds 16384 characters, or names a utility the build did not compile. At build, a warning where a className is built at run time (concatenation, a template hole of unknown values, page data); with strictClasses, at every className the build cannot follow to literals.
UI_CLASS.fix: Write complete Tailwind utility names in literals, const tables, conditionals or cx() arguments.

UI_CLASS_EDGE.when: A border, divide or ring colour is a non-line role at an opacity (`border-text/12`, `ring-text/10`), which high contrast does not strengthen.
UI_CLASS_EDGE.fix: Use a `line` role: `border-line` or `ring-line` for a separator, `border-line-strong` or `ring-line-strong` for an interactive boundary. Exempt: `disabled:` edges, `on-media` edges, a tone's edge on its own `-soft` fill (`border-accent/40 bg-accent-soft`), and a wide inset ring used as a pressed fill (`active:inset-ring-[999px] inset-ring-text/7`).

UI_CLASS_ELEMENT.when: A supported utility is used on an element that does not render it, or a state variant is used on an element that never enters it.
UI_CLASS_ELEMENT.fix: Move layout utilities to the enclosing container and apply state variants only to elements that support them.

UI_CLASS_UNKNOWN.when: A class token is not a Tailwind utility, or is one the build found in no string of the page's sources.
UI_CLASS_UNKNOWN.fix: Replace it with the nearest supported utility named in the message, define a @utility in the theme stylesheet, or write the class as one whole word in a string literal.

UI_CLASS_UNSUPPORTED.when: A Tailwind utility lowers to CSS the native renderer cannot draw.
UI_CLASS_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Use the supported alternative named in the diagnostic or in utilities.md.

UI_COLOR.when: A colour is not a role, currentColor or transparent, or a colour class uses dark:.
UI_COLOR.fix: Use a theme colour role (e.g. bg-surface, text-muted, accent/12) and drop dark: on colours; hex is valid only in vectors, gradients and shadows.

UI_COMMIT.when: A commit was requested without a prepared candidate frame.
UI_COMMIT.fix: Call prepare before commit; do not commit a discarded render.

UI_COMPAT.when: The installed host is older than the compiled page contract.
UI_COMPAT.fix: Update the host app or embedded LingXia SDK to match the compiler version.

UI_COMPOSITE.when: A composited effect (backdrop or opacity group) is out of bounds.
UI_COMPOSITE.fix: Keep composited layers within the page composite bounds.

UI_CONTEXT.when: createContext is not a module-level const, Provider lacks a value or single element child, or the value is not plain data, functions or handles.
UI_CONTEXT.fix: Declare createContext as a module-level const and pass plain data, functions or Local handles to <Ctx.Provider value={...}> wrapping one element.

UI_CSS.when: A stylesheet contains rules other than tokens, or a page imports more than one stylesheet.
UI_CSS.fix: Import at most one stylesheet per page containing only @theme, @utility, @font-face and :root/[data-theme] token blocks.

UI_DOM.when: A DOM global (window, document, localStorage, HTMLElement) is referenced in View code.
UI_DOM.fix: Remove DOM access; use view.env in the View or move platform/storage calls to Logic.

UI_ENVIRONMENT.when: The host reported an invalid View environment.
UI_ENVIRONMENT.fix: Ensure the host adapter supplies a valid viewport, theme, direction and language.

UI_ERROR.when: A failure occurred without a more specific UI_* code.
UI_ERROR.fix: Inspect the error message and JSX stack trace to resolve the thrown exception.

UI_FIELD.when: A wire field reached a tag that does not accept it.
UI_FIELD.fix: Rebuild the page with a matching compiler and host SDK contract.

UI_FIELDS.when: A malformed field list reached the native decoder.
UI_FIELDS.fix: Rebuild the page with a matching compiler and host SDK contract.

UI_FILTER.when: A backdrop filter is outside its allowed bounds.
UI_FILTER.fix: Keep backdrop blur within 0..64px and saturation within 0..16.

UI_FONT.when: A font family is not declared with @font-face, its file is missing, outside the lxapp or too large, or a face could not be read.
UI_FONT.fix: Declare bundled .ttf/.otf/.ttc files (<= 8 MiB) inside the lxapp with @font-face and include a generic fallback.

UI_FRAGMENT.when: A page returns a fragment instead of a single root element.
UI_FRAGMENT.fix: Wrap the page output in a single <page> element.

UI_FRAME.when: The platform presenter kept refusing frames prepared ahead and fell back to one frame at a time.
UI_FRAME.fix: No authoring change required; inspect host presenter logs if frame pacing degrades.

UI_GPU_LOST.when: The GPU device failed mid-frame; after a second failure the page shows its recovery screen.
UI_GPU_LOST.fix: Reload the page; if persistent on one device, verify driver fallback behaviour.

UI_GRADIENT.when: A gradient has geometry its kind does not take, or invalid stops.
UI_GRADIENT.fix: Use linear, radial or conic gradient syntax with 2..16 valid colour stops.

UI_GRID.when: An invalid grid track list or line placement reached layout.
UI_GRID.fix: Use supported CSS grid track functions (up to 64 tracks) and integer/span line placements.

UI_HANDLER.when: An event handler threw or its promise rejected (fails the page in dev/automation, logged in release).
UI_HANDLER.fix: Handle errors inside the event handler or use useAction().run() which returns { ok, error }.

UI_I18N.when: t() names a key no catalogue has, or the lxapp has no i18n/ catalogues.
UI_I18N.fix: Add the key to i18n/<source>.json and regenerate catalogues with lingxia check.

UI_ID.when: Two elements share an id, a popover lacks an id, an id has spaces, or popoverTarget names no popover.
UI_ID.fix: Give each element a unique space-free id (use useId() inside reusable components) and match popoverTarget to an existing popover id.

UI_IMAGE.when: An image source, alt, retryKey or callback is invalid, or loading failed.
UI_IMAGE.fix: Pass a valid package path, lx:// URI or allowed http(s) URL, a string alt, and valid onLoad/onError functions.

UI_INERT.when: A control has no handler, bind or disabled prop, so it is focusable but does nothing.
UI_INERT.fix: Add the control handler or bind prop, or mark the control disabled.

UI_INPUT.when: An editor prop, binding, type combination or text value is invalid.
UI_INPUT.fix: Bind a string useLocal cell (or pass value + onInput) and use min/max/step only on number, date or time inputs.

UI_KEY.when: A sibling key is non-string or duplicated, or a component is keyed by its own function name.
UI_KEY.fix: Use unique non-empty string keys among siblings and never key by Component.name.

UI_LAYOUT.when: A page-bottom wrapper's `<scroll>` or `<List>` shares the wrapper with other in-flow content, so it stops above the bottom bars instead of running on under them.
UI_LAYOUT.fix: Make the scroll the wrapper's only in-flow child and position the rest absolute.

UI_LEAVE.when: A useLeaveGuard call, name, enabled option or answer is invalid.
UI_LEAVE.fix: Pass a unique name, boolean enabled flag, and answer with a boolean.

UI_LIMIT.when: A page-wide or payload limit was exceeded.
UI_LIMIT.fix: Reduce rendered nodes/depth/payload size or switch long lists to <List> (see limits.md).

UI_LINK.when: A <link> has no to, onClick, popoverTarget or interestFor, or a block link nests inside another.
UI_LINK.fix: Give <link> at least one of to, onClick, popoverTarget or interestFor, and do not nest block links.

UI_LIST.when: A <List> description, keys, anchor or row height is invalid.
UI_LIST.fix: Provide unique string keys within itemKeyBytes, valid anchor fields and positive finite row heights.

UI_LOCAL.when: Two useLocal calls share a name in one component, a non-JSON value is stored, or set/focus is called after unmount.
UI_LOCAL.fix: Use distinct names per component, store only plain JSON values, and guard calls after unmount.

UI_LX.when: lx or a value import from @lingxia/logic is used in View code.
UI_LX.fix: Move lx.* calls into a Logic action and invoke that action from the View; use `import type` for types.

UI_MODULE.when: A page module failed to load, imported a reserved path, missed a peer dependency, or mismatched its dev chunk interface.
UI_MODULE.fix: Install missing peer dependencies, import only source/package modules, and rebuild stale pages.

UI_OVERRUN.when: A render exceeded its CPU time budget and was dropped to retry.
UI_OVERRUN.fix: Reduce synchronous render work or move heavy computation to Logic.

UI_PAGE.when: A call reached a page that was already discarded.
UI_PAGE.fix: Stop driving the closed page handle after unmount or navigation.

UI_PARENT.when: A node listed before its parent reached the native decoder.
UI_PARENT.fix: Rebuild the page with a matching @lingxia/view runtime and host SDK.

UI_PATCH.when: An invalid JSON state patch arrived from Logic.
UI_PATCH.fix: Mutate page data only through page.update or page.set with plain JSON values.

UI_PERF.when: More than 50 literal rows sit outside <List>, an opacity/backdrop layer repeats per row, or a bundled image exceeds 2048 px or 8 MiB.
UI_PERF.fix: Use <List> for long lists, move backdrop/opacity to the container or use a translucent role, and downsize large images.

UI_PLOT.when: One or more <plot> props (kind, values, domain, colors, pieLayout, selectedIndex) are invalid.
UI_PLOT.fix: Pass kind (bar|line|pie), 1..128 finite values, domain containing 0 and all values, and 1..16 chart roles.

UI_POPOVER.when: An anchored popover height oscillated between capped and uncapped and was held capped.
UI_POPOVER.fix: Give the popover content a stable height or max-height.

UI_PROP.when: An element received a prop it does not accept, an invalid value, or a conflicting prop combination.
UI_PROP.fix: Remove the unsupported prop or fix its value/combination per elements.md and semantics.md.

UI_RADIO.when: A <radio> has invalid options, value, binding or label.
UI_RADIO.fix: Pass 1..64 options with unique non-empty string values and labels, an aria-label, and a string bind or value + onChange.

UI_RENDER.when: State was mutated or an action/handler API was called during render, or render recursed.
UI_RENDER.fix: Call .set(), .focus() and actions only inside event handlers, never during render.

UI_REQUEST.when: A useRequest call received invalid arguments or a non-unary action.
UI_REQUEST.fix: Pass a unique string name, a unary Logic action from view.actions, and optional JSON params.

UI_ROOT.when: A page render did not return exactly one root element.
UI_ROOT.fix: Return a single <page> element from render().

UI_SCALE.when: A theme scale step is combined with unsupported arithmetic or used on a field that does not accept steps.
UI_SCALE.fix: Use a single pack step (or literal length) without combining two steps or applying min()/max() over steps.

UI_SCOPE.when: A hook or JSX element was evaluated outside render (including JSX at module scope).
UI_SCOPE.fix: Call hooks and construct JSX inside render() or a component/function invoked during render.

UI_SCROLL.when: The host reported an invalid scroll position.
UI_SCROLL.fix: Check the host scroll adapter offset reporting.

UI_SELECT.when: A <select> has invalid options, value, placeholder or selection reply.
UI_SELECT.fix: Pass 1..64 unique { value, label } options, a string value/placeholder, and an aria-label.

UI_SHADOW.when: A boxShadow or ring definition is malformed or exceeds the 8-shadow limit.
UI_SHADOW.fix: Use Tailwind shadow-*/ring-* utilities or pass valid shadow/ring objects within bounds.

UI_SLIDER.when: A <slider> range, step, value, values pair or label is invalid.
UI_SLIDER.fix: Set finite min < max, positive step dividing the range (<= 1e6 steps), aria-label, and valid value or values.

UI_STALE.when: A JSX element handle from an earlier render was reused in a later render.
UI_STALE.fix: Create fresh JSX elements inside each render instead of caching them across renders.

UI_STATE.when: Invalid initial or updated page state arrived from Logic.
UI_STATE.fix: Ensure Logic page data is plain JSON without functions, symbols or circular references.

UI_STREAM.when: A useStream call, listener, sequence or streaming action failed validation.
UI_STREAM.fix: Pass a unique name, an async* streaming action from view.actions, and a function for onData.

UI_STYLE.when: A style property is unknown, unsupported on the element, or uses an invalid combination (sticky outside scroll, layout in state paint).
UI_STYLE.fix: Use only properties accepted by that element in styles.md and paint-only properties inside state variants.

UI_STYLE_STATIC.when: An inline style object contains only fixed literal values.
UI_STYLE_STATIC.fix: Move fixed styles to Tailwind utilities in className and reserve style for computed values.

UI_STYLE_VALUE.when: A style value is out of range or of the wrong type/format.
UI_STYLE_VALUE.fix: Pass a value in the accepted type and range named in the message.

UI_SURFACE.when: The platform GPU surface was lost or resized mid-frame.
UI_SURFACE.fix: No authoring change required; the host recreates the surface and redraws.

UI_TAG.when: An element tag is not part of the View language.
UI_TAG.fix: Replace it with a supported View element from elements.md (e.g. <view>, <text>, <image>).

UI_TEST_ID.when: An invalid data-testid reached the native decoder.
UI_TEST_ID.fix: Use a non-empty string within identifierBytes for data-testid.

UI_TEXT.when: A <span> sits outside <text>, a link label is invalid, the runs of a <text> hold more than `textBytes` of text, or a component inside <text> returns a non-run.
UI_TEXT.fix: Keep <span> inside <text>, split long rich text across <text> elements, and return only runs, popovers or dialogs inside <text>.

UI_TIMEOUT.when: View code repeatedly exceeded its CPU time budget or hung.
UI_TIMEOUT.fix: Optimize or move expensive work to Logic, then reload the page.

UI_TRANSFORM.when: A scaled or rotated box holds an editor, scroll, slider or webview, or a native transform is singular.
UI_TRANSFORM.fix: Translate instead of scaling/rotating containers holding native controls, or transform a sibling.

UI_TRANSITION.when: An invalid transition definition reached the renderer.
UI_TRANSITION.fix: Use transition-* utilities with supported painted properties and durations <= 10 s.

UI_VECTOR.when: A <vector> has invalid paths, viewBox, gradients, stroke or transform props.
UI_VECTOR.fix: Pass 1..32 valid path objects with SVG d strings, a 4-number viewBox, and <= 8 gradients.

UI_VIDEO.when: A <video> source, sources list, poster or control prop is invalid.
UI_VIDEO.fix: Pass a valid src or sources array (not both), valid poster URL, and boolean/number control props in range.

UI_VIEWPORT.when: The host reported an invalid viewport size.
UI_VIEWPORT.fix: Check the host surface viewport dimensions.

UI_WEBVIEW.when: A <webview> source, session handle, label or callback is invalid.
UI_WEBVIEW.fix: Pass a valid src or useWebView() handle, an aria-label, and function callbacks.

UI_WORKER.when: The View worker thread failed to start.
UI_WORKER.fix: Restart the app or check host OS thread limits.
